title: Trip Interruption Benefit Terms of the Cardinal Roadside Assistance Endorsement
content:
## Benefit

Where the Cardinal Roadside Assistance option includes trip interruption, a covered disablement that leaves the vehicle undrivable at least the option's minimum distance from the member's home address and needs an overnight repair is eligible for trip interruption. The benefit pays:

- lodging, up to the option's lodging limit per night;
- meals, up to the option's meals limit per day;
- alternate transportation home or to the destination;

for no more than the option's maximum number of days, and all together never more than the option's maximum for the disablement. The maximum for the disablement is measured against the total of trip interruption amounts paid for that one disablement, that is, under its one dispatch number.

Expenses need itemized receipts, and each receipt is paid once in each expense category.

## Schedule of trip interruption terms

| Option | Trip interruption included | Minimum distance from home | Lodging per night | Meals per day | Most days | Most for one disablement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Roadside Basic | No | 0 miles | $0 | $0 | 0 | $0 |
| Cardinal Roadside Standard | No | 0 miles | $0 | $0 | 0 | $0 |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus | No | 0 miles | $0 | $0 | 0 | $0 |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption | Yes | 100 miles | $100 | $40 | 3 | $500 |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier | Yes | 100 miles | $150 | $60 | 5 | $1000 |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer | Yes | 100 miles | $150 | $60 | 5 | $1500 |

On the options showing "No", trip interruption expenses are not covered.

## The distance threshold, both sides

The disablement must leave the vehicle undrivable at least 100 miles from the member's home address on every option that includes the benefit.

| Hypothetical distance from home | Meets the distance term? |
|---|---|
| 100 miles | Yes: "at least 100 miles" includes 100 |
| 99 miles | No |

## Worked example (hypothetical expenses)

Option: Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption. Covered disablement 240 miles from home, vehicle undrivable, overnight repair needed. Itemized receipts: lodging at $120 a night for 3 nights, meals of $50 a day for 3 days, and a one-way rental car home for $150.

1. Lodging: each night is paid up to $100, so 3 nights give $300.
2. Meals: each day is paid up to $40, so 3 days give $120.
3. Alternate transportation: $150.
4. Days: the expenses span 3 days, which is within the 3 days allowed.
5. Total of the items: $570. The most for one disablement on this option is $500, so $500 is paid.

Had the repair kept the car 4 nights, lodging and meals for no more than 3 days would be paid.

## Payments already made for the disablement

Hypothetical: on Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption, $420 has already been paid for one disablement. A further meals receipt for that same disablement can bring the total to no more than $500, so no more than $80 more is paid for it.
